items.title: MPH native ARM7 reuse
items.decision: MPH ARM7 reuse: one matched NAS pair CPU6.328125->5.9375s (-6.17284percent),wall5.271864->4.869309s (+8.26718percent throughput). Focused tests/freshboot/basicvisual/currentbuildrestore pass. Included for final bundle owner check.

items.title: Native fallbacks
items.decision: MPH CPU -13.72percent and throughput +4.31percent in matched NAS pair. MKDS CPU +2.91percent, reverse +4.64percent despite neutral wall: exclude for MKDS; retain MPH only.

items.title: Animation and skinning
items.decision: Existing complete vector/affine services execute in both games; remaining ordinary arithmetic is already CPU-native. Current boundary census identifies SDK/device/control work, but does not identify a complete hot animation/skinning job with a defensible caller/state/alias contract. No additional safe profitable whole-job replacement established; defer broader semantic reverse engineering, do not claim absence of future opportunity.

items.title: Model setup and geometry
items.decision: Send-only matches original initial race scene and passes512 original-code cases/currentbuildrestore/basicvisual. Matched NAS CPU11.9375->11.984375s (+0.39percent),wall8.4376473->8.5473243s (-1.28percent throughput): neutral/inconclusive, no demonstrated gain. No additional useful replacement established; keep existing native CPU/device ingress and leave duplicate service out. Source retained privately for reproduction.

items.title: Bulk memory operations
items.decision: Observed MKDS Send32 body849695 entries versus fill683/full Send322849; largest bulk handoff is device ingress covered by N04. Long RAM copy bodies have no observed host entries, which is not proof of zero linked execution. No demonstrated large copy/decode cost justifies bypassing normal alias/provenance/code-write/yield handling. Ordinary memory instructions already native; no additional raw memcpy/decompress replacement retained.

items.title: ARM7 sound-driver updates
items.decision: Both ARM7 instruction streams execute natively; MKDS remaining stops include MUL/status and BIOS SWI1B/1C. Full driver replacement would need voice/IPC/exception/banked-state/timing contracts not established by these PCs. Hardware SPU mixing already host-native (~0.14/0.20ms per diagnostic frame MPH/MKDS); exact tier3 ARM7 about0.15/0.17ms. Native ARM7 gains retained; no guessed BIOS/audio completion HLE.

items.title: Code validation and invalidation
items.decision: First version rejected. Revised exact physical page notifications skip writer duplication and use negative-only bloom filter. Comparison counts62.49m->21.35m MPH,119.94m->36.07m MKDS; small mixed timing is neutral/inconclusive, no proven speedup. Focused alias/DMA/SMC checks pass; guest sections match except verified unused FIFO padding. No further tuning.

items.title: RAM/device handoffs
items.decision: V1 slower MPH CPU+29.43percent/throughput-3.24percent. Deadline-bounded v2 passes1024 original-code cases and actualgame sanity/restore with nonzero coalescence. MPH pair CPU6.125->6.140625s (+0.26percent),wall4.6077683->4.5885284s (+0.42percent throughput): neutral. MKDS CPU12.359375->12.625s (+2.15percent),wall8.3467335->8.7410417s (-4.51percent throughput): slower. No retained division helper; stop after two versions, preserve real bus/math model. Experimental services and deadline getter removed from production source; private full source/tests/raw evidence retained.

items.title: Graphics capture/presentation
items.decision: Existing NativeGL/capture-view reuse for MPH and Compute/window composition for MKDS remain. Current diagnostic exact3D frame bucket is3.21ms MPH and0.50ms MKDS; busy local host prevents a production ceiling claim, and disabled finer GL counters are zeros, not evidence of no cost. Prior measured MKDS readback0.218ms/frame and submit0.265ms/frame are historical diagnostics. No new demonstrated avoidable capture copy or missing native renderer found; replacing integer guest-capture pixels with presentation output lacks equivalence proof. Defer new renderer architecture.

items.title: Scheduling and CPU publication
items.decision: Current estimated scheduler other0.72/0.78ms/frame, context publication0.018/0.038ms, next-event0.098/0.112ms (busy diagnostic attribution only). Exact deadline-cache prototype already lost2.21percent CPU; do not rerun unchanged. N07 reduces repeated validation, N02/N08/N04 reduce avoidable CPU exits. Further larger windows or parallel CPUs require a new shared RAM/IPC/DMA/event contract and demonstrated incremental cost; no additional scheduler change retained.

budget: one diagnostic per game plus one600-frame MPH ARM7 matchedpair; subsequent pairs only for viable affected packages
